name: Blooming Jijioa
description: An invisible solar fare causes this patch of unassuming ground cover to suddenly bloom into a radioactive feld.
disable: DC 22 Survival (trained) to remove a 5-foot square of jijioa, or 5 points of fire damage to destroy an affected area
reset: An hour after blooming, a jijioa patch goes dormant for 1 week.

generalAbilities.name: Solar Bloom
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The jijioa patch is exposed to a solar fare

Effect The countless jijioa flowers suddenly bloom, magnifying the ambient heat of the sun a hundredfold. Creatures in the jijioa patch take 4d6 Fire Damage (Basic DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw). Creatures that end their turn in the patch continue to take damage in this way as long as the jijioa is in bloom.
